Name: Anthro Clint - Brown Bear Mod
Author: enogeko
Description:
This mod is essentially a personal furry reskin of Clint, who's always given me big brown bear energy ^^ will be updated ASAP once the 1.7 update comes out for the canon marry-able Clint experience! For now, enjoy this small reimagining of mine!! 

[b]NOTES:[/b]
- Because I'm super dumb and didn't do any research, I made a 128x128 portrait version first which ISN'T compatible with the original game and needs an additional mod in order to work. I've included a 64x64 (but low quality) portrait version for the people who want a more vanilla experience or for people who don't want to install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999?tab=description]Portraiture[/url], but I highly recommend using the original 128x128 version since I didn't rush that one...

- This mod was made with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued[/url] mod in mind, and it *should* be perfectly compatible with it (as long as you don't mess with its file name and mod load order). If you're experiencing problems and the mods clash for whatever reason, try downloading the optional base.json file and replacing the base.json of the AnthroCharactersContinued mod which is in /Mods/AnthroCharactersContinued/assets/AnthroConfig/base.json. It should remove all the clashing Clint edits between mods that way (Credits to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ImRikun]ImRikun[/url] for the solution T-T).

- Thanks for checking my mod out! Next on my to-do list is giving him seasonal outfits and making a version for Clint Reforged, so stay tuned for that.


[b]INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:
[/b]1.) Make sure to have all the dependencies first (SMAPI, Content Patcher, Portraiture for the 128x128 portrait version)
2.) Download and extract the Clint Bear Mod, and then drag and drop it into your Mods folder.
3.) FOR THE 128x128 VERSION (OPTIONAL BUT HIGHLY RECOMMENDED):
Install and follow [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999?tab=description]Portraiture[/url] instructions. Place the "128 Furry Clint Version" in the Mods\Portraiture\Portraits folder. You have to follow Portraiture instructions and press "P" while the dialogue box is open until you see the correct version, and then you're done!
